name: Liquid Meter
description: This will output a quantity in litres and the total capacity in litres. If not inside an enclosed volume, it will give the height relative to the water surface.
shortDescription: A device to measure how much liquid is within an enclosed volume.

logicNodes.label: Liquid Level
logicNodes.description: Returns the number of litres of liquid in an enclosed volume, or height relative to water if not enclosed.

logicNodes.label: Fluid Capacity
logicNodes.description: Returns the total capacity of an enclosed volume in litres, or 0 if not enclosed.

logicNodes.label: Composite Data
logicNodes.description: Outputs the volumes of individual liquid types on their respective channel. The data can be directly merged with a Gas meter. Channels: 1-Water, 2-Diesel, 3-Jet Fuel, 6-Oil, 7-Seawater, 9-Slurry, 10-Saturated Slurry
